summary_1line: Arjuna captures King Drupada for Drona, who humiliates him but restores half his kingdom; later Yudhishthira is named heir and the Pandavas’ skills flourish.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna leaps from his chariot with a scimitar and seizes King Drupada on his own chariot like Garuda grasping a great serpent.
Drona stands before the captured and humbled Drupada, calmly offering him back half his kingdom across the river Bhagirathi.
In the royal court, Dhritarashtra installs Yudhishthira as heir while the Kuru princes look on.
